text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI can create art, compose music, and even write stories. These tools are powerful and can produce surprisingly good results. However, many people believe that human creativity is different. While AI can copy styles and combine ideas, it does not have feelings or personal experiences. Human artists create from emotion, memory, and imagination. For example, a song written by a person often tells a real story or shares true feelings. AI can support our work, but it cannot replace the human touch that makes art meaningful.
